set.body:
Problem: HrfSpec.scala:35-53 defines 18 HrfKinds, but formula basis = resolves 9 (EventModelBuilder.scala:3313-3322: spmg1/2/3, gamma, gaussian, fir, bspline, tent, fourier). lwu, cascade34, mexhat, inv_logit, half_cosine, daguerre, sine, boxcar and weighted are reachable only through caller-supplied hrfFuns, which portable JSON refuses; HrfKind aliases (spmg, gam, bs) are rejected.

Consumer need: the studio response gallery (spec section 2.5; G6). The six bases the studio needs are reachable, so this is not blocking.

Acceptance:
- Every admitted HrfKind parses, prints and builds from formula text with named parameters; aliases accepted or documented as rejected.
- Unknown kinds keep a positioned error; JVM+JS tests.

Out of scope: new kernels.
Provenance: verified read-only 2026-10-08 against ScalaFIM main ea6fe3ad for the PLS Neuro model studio (plsneuro review bd-01M4DMGP1QFSQX9Z5V91B4B12F; spec docs/plans/2026-10-02-model-studio-spec.md and GRAMMAR-NEEDS.md on plsneuro main).
set.title: Resolve every admitted HrfKind from formula basis =
